interpretation_limits: DeepDRiD has two views and cannot establish multi-step non-myopic planning value.
The hindsight stop oracle uses true labels only for retrospective analysis of cross-fitted or sealed held-out predictions; it is not a deployable stopping policy.
If visual and swapped suffix mappings produce materially different conclusions, field mapping remains a blocker pending official confirmation.

prediction_scope_note.allowed_non_crossfit_use: sealed held-out predictions may be used for final test reporting, but not for training, calibration, or hindsight policy selection.

view_mapping_note: Sensitivity-only mapping. Public DeepDRiD metadata reviewed so far does not explicitly state the filename suffix-to-field mapping. Run this config beside configs/deepdrid.yaml; if conclusions change materially, treat field mapping as a blocker pending author confirmation.
